setting: local journalism — small community newspaper newsroom
head_pair: (a) H2 defenseless specific party wronged whose good name/livelihood was publicly wrecked + H4 front-page publicity before the whole town  vs  (b) H3 deliberate, un-repented continuance of shaded facts over three months
case_a_worse: Q145 forbids slandering and 'prejudicing... our neighbour's good name'; Q151 head 2 aggravates by the helplessness of the party wronged. (a) is a fabricated public corruption accusation that destroyed a specific defenseless private citizen's name and livelihood — an actual innocent neighbor ruined — splashed front-page before the whole town (head 4 publicity). A real, defenseless human victim publicly and irreparably harmed by a false charge is the gravest thing the ninth commandment guards against; a lie that wrecks a helpless neighbor's name before the whole community outweighs low-stakes filler shading with no victim.
case_b_worse: Q151 head 3 marks deliberateness and continuance as the hardest aggravation; un-repented persistence is heavier than a single act. (b) is a three-month settled, deliberate, willful habit of dishonesty, returned to again and again, and never once admitted or corrected — the hardened, un-repented character-corruption the Standards mark most gravely. (a), whatever its public damage, was a single act; (b) reveals a settled disposition of lying that will keep producing falsehood. A reporter who is settledly, unrepentantly dishonest by habit is a graver problem than one bad act.
why_neither_wins: The Standards give no algebra to net the public destruction of a defenseless neighbor's good name (once, head 2 + head 4) against a deliberate, un-repented three-month continuance of dishonesty (head 3). Different uncancelled heads: (a)'s single-occurrence texture does NOT cancel (b)'s continuance, and (b)'s no-named-victim/low-stakes texture does NOT cancel (a)'s party-and-publicity weight. Neither side is a mitigation-loaded straw scenario — both carry live, uncancelled aggravations the other lacks.

head_pair: (a) gravest KIND of the sin — express blasphemous cursing of God (Q151 head-3 nature-and-quality, Q113), single act, no office, barely heard  vs  (b) H2 a specific vulnerable child whose reverence is mocked + H3 settled continuance week after week after admonition, of a lighter kind
case_a_worse: Q113 marks express profane/blasphemous abuse of the name as the deepest kind of the third-commandment sin; Q151 head 3 aggravates by the nature and quality of the offence. (a) is outright cursing of God directly, calling down damnation on His name — the gravest KIND of the sin against this very commandment, the deepest direct abuse of the name itself. That a lie or a jest wounds men; blasphemy strikes at God. The sheer kind of the act (blaspheming God to His face) is the most direct violation of the commandment, and its gravity does not depend on who happened to hear it — the offense is against God, not the audience.
case_b_worse: Q151 head 2 aggravates by the helplessness and tenderness of the party wronged; head 3 by continuance. (b) repeatedly uses God's name to mock and shame a specific vulnerable child — an earnest, shy twelve-year-old — jeering at his praying week after week until the boy is ashamed to pray at all, and it has not stopped after admonition. Turning the holy name into a weapon to wound the weak and drive a child from his devotion engages both the helplessness of the party (head 2) and the hardened, warned-and-continued persistence (head 3). A single outburst against no one passes; a settled campaign of mockery that crushes a child's reverence and teaches him shame is a spreading, personal harm to a defenseless soul.
why_neither_wins: No algebra nets (a)'s gravest-KIND-of-the-sin (express blasphemy, once, from no office, barely heard) against (b)'s wounding-of-a-vulnerable-child plus settled continuance (a lighter kind, aimed and repeated). Different uncancelled heads: (a)'s single-occurrence-and-no-office does not cancel its gravest-kind weight, nor (b)'s party/continuance; (b)'s lighter kind does not cancel (a)'s gravest-kind. This recast switches (b)'s aggravation from H1-example to H2-vulnerable-party and drops the public-before-children H4 from (a), so the pair is no longer a pole-swap of banked CONT-N-022 (leader-flippant-repeated vs nobody-gravest-kind-public) and no longer twins in-batch CONT-N-045's office-vs-gravest-kind mold. The head-3 grader-mapping note authorizes 'the kind/nature of the act itself (express blasphemy)' as (a)'s H3 anchor.

setting: farm/agriculture — family produce farm with seasonal crews
head_pair: (a) H3 deliberate continuance/relapse-after-warning over two seasons, against the owner  vs  (b) H2 parties defrauded are the weak/poorest/most-dependent migrant hands
case_a_worse: Q151 head 3 marks deliberateness and continuance-after-admonition as the hardest aggravation. (a) is a two-season entrenched skimming scheme, warned once, falsely promised to stop, then resumed — relapse-after-warning, the hardened persistence the Standards mark most gravely. It is settled, deliberate, and unstoppable by admonition; the offender's will is fixed in the sin. That fixed, warned-and-relapsing character is graver than a single bounded scheme.
case_b_worse: Q151 head 2 aggravates by the helplessness and dependence of the party wronged; Q142 condemns withholding wages from the needy. (b) defrauds the poorest, most defenseless migrant hands — people with no other options and no way to complain — taking the very bread they depend on for survival. Oppressing the weakest and most dependent, stealing subsistence wages from the helpless, is the oppression-of-the-poor the Standards mark most gravely. Theft aimed at the defenseless is worse than theft from an owner who can absorb it.
why_neither_wins: No algebra nets (a)'s deliberate-relapsing-continuance-after-warning (against the owner, who can bear the loss) against (b)'s defrauding of the weakest and most dependent (a single scheme, but aimed at those who can least bear it). Different uncancelled heads: (a)'s theft-against-the-owner is lighter on head 2; (b)'s single-scheme scale is lighter on head 3. Neither texture cancels the other's live aggravation. This is the mirror of CONT-N-020's H3-vs-H4 but on the H3-vs-H2 axis, and inverts CONT-N-005's party-arrangement.

setting: small law office — small firm (managing partner)
head_pair: (a) H1 senior partner whose example the firm follows, a single advance  vs  (b) H3 deliberate continuance/relapse-after-repeated-warning over a year, cultivated occasions
case_a_worse: Q151 head 1 aggravates by the offender's eminency and example; Q139 forbids unchaste solicitations. (a) is an advance from the senior partner every associate and clerk patterns their conduct on — the man who sets the firm's whole standard of how to be a lawyer. When the modeled exemplar crosses this line, he corrupts the very standard the firm learns from, and the example-weight makes his single act structurally worse than misconduct by a nobody.
case_b_worse: Q151 head 3 marks deliberateness and continuance-after-admonition hardest. (b) is a year-long entrenched pattern of soliciting dependent clients and paralegals, warned twice, promised twice to stop, and resumed each time — relapse-after-repeated-warning, the fixed hardened persistence the Standards mark most gravely, plus the cultivated occasions (Q139). A will fixed in relapsing predation, unstoppable by repeated admonition, is graver than one bounded incident.
why_neither_wins: No algebra nets (a)'s office/example weight (a single advance from the firm's model) against (b)'s deliberate-relapsing-continuance-after-repeated-warning (from a nobody). Different uncancelled heads: (a)'s single occurrence is lighter on head 3; (b)'s no-office/no-example is lighter on head 1. Neither cancels the other. NOTE (distinguishing from CONT-N-040): 040 pairs H2+H4 vs H3; this item pairs H1 vs H3 — a genuinely different mold. NOTE re mitigation rule: (b)'s promises-to-stop are NOT mitigations that spare (b) — they are the false-assurance-then-relapse that AGGRAVATES (b) (CONT-N-013 device), so (b) is not a mitigation-loaded side.

head_pair: (a) H2 using authority to keep the weak/new-believers from public worship against conscience, harming their souls  vs  (b) H3 willful weekly continuance in unnecessary Sabbath work + H4 done openly before the whole church-going town
case_a_worse: Q151 head 2 aggravates by the helplessness of the party wronged and by the offense reaching the souls of others; Q118 charges those in authority NOT to hinder but to require the day's keeping by those under them. (a) inverts that duty: she uses control of their hours to compel the weakest, lowest-paid, new-believer staff to miss worship against their conscience. Wounding the souls of the weak, binding their consciences, and hindering their worship via authority is the gravest thing here — it harms others' souls, not just her own duty.
case_b_worse: Q119 forbids unnecessary worldly work on the day; Q151 head 3 marks deliberate weekly continuance, and head 4 marks the public scandal. (b) is willful, every-Sunday, unnecessary Sabbath-breaking, AND it is done openly on the town's main streets before the whole church-going community — the municipal crew publicly teaching the town to hold the Lord's Day cheaply. A settled, deliberate, PUBLIC profaning by the town's own crew scandalizes the whole community and models Sabbath-contempt at civic scale.
why_neither_wins: No algebra nets (a)'s authority-misuse-harming-the-souls-of-the-weak (a quiet arrangement) against (b)'s willful-weekly-continuance-plus-public-scandal (harming his own/crew's duty, not compelling the weak). Different uncancelled heads: (a) is lighter on publicity/continuance; (b) is lighter on party-offended (no weak souls compelled). Neither texture cancels the other. Draws on CONT-N-007's H2-authority-inversion for (a) but pairs it against a head-3+head-4 side, not another party-offended side.

setting: local journalism — small community Christian radio station (station manager)
head_pair: (a) H1 flagship host whose example the region follows, settled repeated devised will-worship of a lighter kind  vs  (b) gravest KIND of the sin — outright image/creature-worship (Q151 head-3 nature-and-quality, Q109), from no office, once
case_a_worse: Q151 head 1 aggravates by the offender's example; Q109 forbids devising religious worship not instituted by God (will-worship). (a) is the flagship host the whole region trusts and models its devotion on, repeatedly broadcasting an invented ritual — training the entire trusting audience into a devised worship, week after week, from the most-modeled voice. The office/example weight plus continuance corrupts the worship of everyone who follows him; the harm propagates region-wide.
case_b_worse: Q109 marks the making and worshipping of an image as the deepest kind of the second-commandment sin; Q151 head 3 aggravates by the nature and quality of the act. (b) is outright creature-worship — leading listeners to pray to and venerate an image, address it as an object of worship. That is idolatry itself, the gravest kind of the sin against this commandment. The sheer kind of the act (bowing to and praying to an image) is a deeper corruption than a devised-but-non-idolatrous ritual gimmick.
why_neither_wins: No algebra nets (a)'s office/example weight and continuance (a lighter kind from the voice the region follows) against (b)'s gravest-kind (image-worship, from no following, once). Different uncancelled heads: (a)'s lighter kind does not cancel (b)'s office/example; (b)'s single-occurrence/no-office does not cancel its gravest-kind, nor (a)'s example weight. Mirrors the CONT-N-022 head-1-vs-gravest-kind structure but on the second commandment (C2, a thin slot) with the head-3 grader-mapping note for the kind-of-the-act anchor.

head_pair: (a) H2 party dishonored is one he stands especially-related-and-obligated-unto (his own father who raised him) + H3 continuance over a year  vs  (b) H1 senior grower whose example is followed + H4 done publicly at the packed meeting before those who copy him
case_a_worse: Q127 owes honor most to those in a parent's place; Q151 head 2 aggravates by the nearness and obligation of the relation, head 3 by continuance. (a) is a year-long settled campaign of undermining his own father — the man who raised and taught him, to whom he owes the most honor of anyone. Sustained, deliberate dishonor toward the one he is most bound to honor, deepened by year-long continuance, is the relational disloyalty the Standards mark most gravely. The private setting doesn't lighten the betrayal of the most-obligated relation.
case_b_worse: Q151 head 1 aggravates by the offender's example, head 4 by public place. (b) is open contempt of the co-op's authority at the packed annual meeting, from the senior grower every younger member models their conduct on, before exactly those who copy him — publicly teaching the whole watching membership to hold leadership in contempt. The public example of contempt from the man they all imitate propagates disrespect for authority through the entire cooperative.
why_neither_wins: No algebra nets (a)'s especially-related-plus-continuance dishonor (private, from a nobody) against (b)'s example-plus-publicity contempt (single act, apologized for). Different uncancelled heads: (a) is lighter on office/publicity; (b) is lighter on relation/continuance. NOTE re mitigation rule: (b)'s apology-afterward is a MITIGATION and does NOT cancel (a)'s aggravations — but (b) still carries its OWN uncancelled H1+H4 aggravations of the act itself, so (b) is NOT a mitigation-loaded straw side. This is the CONT-N-005 shape (H1+H4 vs H2+H3) ported to C5 in a farm-co-op setting; verified both sides carry live aggravations.

head_pair: (a) H3 done 'with delight'/relish against one victim  vs  (b) H2 parties offended are the weak/vulnerable/'many' + H3 continuance over a year
case_a_worse: Q151 head 3 marks sins done 'with delight' as aggravated in their very quality — settled complacency in another's hurt is a deeper corruption than passion. (a) is deliberate cruelty to a grieving worker, done with obvious relish, the supervisor enjoying and sharpening the man's pain. The delight-in-another's-suffering is a depth of malice (Q136 provoking words) that a cold, impersonal pattern lacks; the quality of gleeful cruelty marks a corrupted heart the Standards weigh heavily.
case_b_worse: Q151 head 2 aggravates by the helplessness and by the breadth ('many') of the parties wounded; head 3 by continuance. (b) grinds down MANY of the weakest workers — new hires, the disabled on light duty, the anxious — over a whole year of methodical belittling, until several quit. Breadth of vulnerable victims plus year-long continuance is a vast cumulative harm aimed squarely at the weak; that many defenseless people are worn down and driven off is graver than a single cruel incident, however gleeful.
why_neither_wins: No algebra nets (a)'s delight-in-cruelty against one against (b)'s cold, sustained, many-vulnerable wearing-down. Different uncancelled heads: (a)'s single-victim scale is lighter on head 2/continuance; (b)'s cold-not-gleeful manner is lighter on the head-3 'with delight' pole. Neither texture cancels the other's live aggravation. This is the CONT-N-004 shape (delight-vs-many-vulnerable-continuance) ported to a municipal public-works setting; both sides carry uncancelled aggravations on different heads.
